title: Patient Payment Plans Fee Schedule Note: Amount of the Signing Setup Fee
content:
The signing setup fee of the Patient Payment Plans is charged, on a tier whose setup fee is above 0.00, as one enrollment entry of the reason setup fee on the plan balance, booked on the signing date.

**Amount.** The setup fee is scheduled at the tier's setup fee, the one-time setup fee shown for that tier in the fee and installment schedule of the Patient Payment Plans. The fee entered on the plan balance is the scheduled setup fee rounded half up to the cent.

| Quantity | How it is set |
|---|---|
| Scheduled setup fee | The tier's setup fee |
| Setup fee entered | The scheduled setup fee, rounded half up to the cent |
| Date of the entry | The signing date |

**Rounding.** Rounding half up to the cent takes an amount exactly halfway between two cents to the higher cent. A tier setup fee stated in whole cents is entered unchanged.

**Worked figure (hypothetical tier fee).** For a tier whose setup fee were 32.50, the scheduled setup fee is 32.50 and the fee entered on the signing date is 32.50.

**Points of judgement.**

- *What is the base of the fee?* The tier's own setup fee, read from the fee and installment schedule for the tier the patient signs.
- *When is it booked?* On the signing date, as one entry.
- *Is it charged on a tier whose setup fee is 0.00?* No; such a tier books no setup-fee entry.
